plugins.name: godw-design
plugins.description: godw design-pipeline plugin (world-first per research; mechanism hardened by real run then finalized via modify-plan). Document chain: raw requirement GOAL.md -> formalized 原始需求.md (FR/NFR numbered, frozen) -> four standalone architecture docs 业务架构/信息架构/应用架构/技术架构 with field-level single source of truth in 4A架构/detail.json -> interactive prototype (JSON-mock DB, real navigation, real state transitions, delegated to godw-html lo-fi line). godw-design-* skill family: start (two-stage orchestrator 1a..2c, stage-by-stage manual launch, requirement backflow v2 with legs absorbing gated increments as GR-ids while 原始需求 stays frozen, version lines + pass snapshots, design/change/{date}_{name} instances auto-archived to design/archive/), requirement-formalize (GOAL->原始需求+术语, completeness gate, deletes source), requirement-split (directional decomposition, rerunnable), gate (convergence registry + anchor card + explore-to-converge rhythm + blocker admission + regression-juror-only verdicts — fixes the never-converging blind-rejury flaw from the first 8-FAIL run), check (mechanical consistency gate: trace-chain validity, anti-fabrication, cross-refs, terminology; runs after every revision without consuming juror rounds). + 3 fixed juror subagents in agents/ (arch-reviewer 7-dimension / simplicity-officer anti-bloat / dev-reproduce exam, read-only tools) + ID traceability FR/NFR/GR through the whole chain. Sibling plugins: godw-goal, godw-html, godw-toolkit. v0.2.1: 3-tier launch (start plain / document+prototype must /goal) + stage handover card (structured next-step with copyable prompt); reference-materials folder with index section in requirement doc (sole freeze exception); prototype default multi-file layout (index.html + pages/ + data.js + assets/, mandatory for >=6 pages); execution hardening (juror waves <=6-7, quota-failure re-dispatch not counting rounds, grep-verify after edits, snapshots include trace table).

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: Godw Design：设计流水线域（需求→四架构文档→可交互原型）

description_i18n.zh-CN: godw设计流水线域插件（实测进化后定稿）。文档链：GOAL.md → 原始需求.md（FR/NFR 编号，冻结）→ 业务/信息/应用/技术四独立文档（字段级唯一源 4A架构/detail.json）→ 可交互原型（JSON 模拟库+跳转+状态流转，委托 godw-html lo-fi 线）。godw-design-* 技能族系：start 两阶段编排（1a分解/1b成文/1c门1/2a原型/2b门2/2c收口归档，支持分段手动启动；回流协议 v2 原始需求永冻+两腿吸收 GR 编号；版本行+过门快照）+ requirement-formalize（完备性关卡+术语首建+删源）+ requirement-split + gate（收敛登记表+锚定卡+两期节奏+blocker 准入+回归评委判定——修复首跑 8 轮全 FAIL 不收敛）+ check（一致性机械门：追踪链/防假链/防发明/互引/术语，不耗评委轮次）+ agents/ 三固定评叶子智能体（七维/反膨胀/复现考试，只读）+ ID 全链贯穿。按名调用 godw-goal/godw-html/godw-toolkit。 v0.2.1：三档启动（document/prototype 必须 /goal）+阶段衔接卡片；参考资料/+原始需求索引节（冻结例外）；原型默认多文件组织（≥6页必须）；执行韧性（波次≤6-7/配额补派/替换复核/快照含追踪表）。
